job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Mandatory Technical Skills

Strong programming experience in Python
Hands-on experience with Generative AI / Large Language Models
Experience with RAG architecture
Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, transformers, and NLP
Prompt Engineering and LLM application development
Experience with one or more:
LangChain
LangGraph
LlamaIndex
Semantic Kernel
Experience with Vector Databases / Vector Search
REST API / Microservices development
Experience with at least one cloud platform:
AWS
Microsoft Azure
Google Cloud
Understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning
Git, CI/CD and software engineering practices

Good to Have

Experience with Agentic AI / Multi-Agent Systems
LLM fine-tuning / PEFT / LoRA
Hugging Face Transformers
PyTorch / TensorFlow
Knowledge of MLOps / LLMOps
Model evaluation and observability
AI safety, governance, and security
Knowledge of Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
Experience with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or equivalent
Experience integrating GenAI with enterprise systems such as SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, CRM/ERP platforms
Knowledge of multimodal AI involving text, image, audio, or video
